method: LiDAR floor-plane + seven LiDAR pole stem clusters; manually seeded ZED base-dark-blob localization; fixed camera height from ZED NEURAL depth floor; 2D reprojection fit

frames.destination: ZED rectified left camera IMAGE coordinates (x right, y down, z forward)

fit.note: This is not a true independent 6-DOF solution: centers are approximately collinear; floor normals and height priors fix otherwise weak degrees of freedom.

assumptions_and_risks: camera height fixed using one depth-derived floor plane (NEURAL depth); fit differs in pitch by around 1.16 degrees
ZED pole base centers were seeded from human inspection then refined by negative difference relative to empty-frame grayscale
points from central-corridor ROI may contain outliers or beam/shadow returns
The outer diameter of the pole base may bias center in image; use calibrated marker or off-axis ground points to independently validate
do not substitute as final camera-lidar extrinsics without validation on door corners or off-axis markers

cross_sensor_static_scene_check.caveat: Pixel-wise correspondence in large static surfaces, not an independent metric ground-truth pose calibration; depth error and occlusions rise at long range.
